nodes.label: PosteriorActionIdentityLedger
nodes.subtitle: BanditRLProof.Thompson.PosteriorActionIdentityLedger
nodes.description: Source contract for the Thompson probability-matching identity. The ledger records the exact law expected from a Thompson action sampler: its action kernel at a history agrees on every measurable action event with the posterior distribution pushed forward by the environment-to-best-action map. It is a contract surface, not a Bayes-rule proof or posterior-sampler construction.

nodes.label: actionKernel_apply_singleton_eq_posteriorBest_preimage
nodes.subtitle: BanditRLProof.Thompson.PosteriorActionIdentityLedger.actionKernel_apply_singleton_eq_posteriorBest_preimage
nodes.description: Singleton form of the posterior action identity. For discrete or singleton-measurable action spaces, the Thompson probability of choosing `action` is the posterior probability that `action` is the best action.
nodes.statement: theorem actionKernel_apply_singleton_eq_posteriorBest_preimage [MeasurableSingletonClass Action] (ledger : PosteriorActionIdentityLedger History Env Action) (history : History) (action : Action) : ledger.actionKernel history ({action} : Set Action) = ledger.posterior.kernel history {env : Env | ledger.bestAction env = action}

nodes.description: Thompson probability matching in Mathlib `condDistrib` form.
